name: Lebanon
description: Lebanon from the Phoenicians of Byblos, Tyre and Sidon to Rome, the emirs, the French mandate, civil war and today.

checkpoints.name: Phoenicia
checkpoints.note: Byblos is among the oldest towns. The Phoenicians sailed the sea and spread the alphabet.

checkpoints.name: Empires
checkpoints.note: Rome, the Arabs, crusaders and the Ottomans ruled.

checkpoints.name: Lebanon
checkpoints.note: France made Greater Lebanon in 1920; it became free in 1943. Civil war tore it apart from 1975 to 1990.
